scope: Opaque credential profiles, runtime-only resolution, exact connector/server/tool scope, reload on reconnect, typed content-free authentication failures, and secret echo denial before normalization.

three_amigos.requirement: Criteria C01-C06 in docs/connector-credentials-v1.md are implemented and component-qualified. Live provider deployment and installed outbound binary qualification remain parent EPIC-07 work.
three_amigos.architecture: Credential values are owned by the daemon runtime; application records contain only profile references and typed failures.
three_amigos.automation: Reloadable resolver and CredentialedStdioFactory are composable behind the existing private MCP host transport port.
three_amigos.testing: A real synthetic stdio subprocess receives a scoped canary credential, echoes it in tool output, and is denied before normalization. Unit coverage includes scope denials, reload, auth failure classification, direct-stdio bypass rejection, unprofiled environment denial and diagnostic redaction.
three_amigos.review_provenance: Requirement, architecture, automation and tester role passes performed by one agent; no independent review is claimed.
